content:
D{D}anced in the morning when the world was young, I d{A}anced in the moon and the st{G}ars and the s{A}un,
I c{D}ame down from Heaven and I danced on Earth, at B{A}ethlehem I h{G}ad m{A}y b{D}irth.
D{D}ance, dance wherever you may be I am The Lord Of The D{A}ance, said he,
And I′ll l{D}ead you all, wherever you may be and I'll l{A}ead you all in the d{G}ance, s{A}aid {D}he.


I danced for the scribe and the Pharisee, they would not dance; they wouldn't follow me,
So I danced for the fisherman James and John they came with me and the dance went on.

I danced on the Sabbath and I cured the lame, they holy people said it was a shame.
So they whipped and they stripped and they hung me high and they left me on the cross to die.

I danced on a Friday, when the sky turned black, its hard to dance with the Devil in your back.
Oh they buried my body and they thought I was gone, but I am the dance and the dance went on.

They cut me down, but I leapt on high, I am the light that never will die,
But I'll live in you if you'll live in me, I am The Lord Of The Dance, said he.
title: Lord of the Dance
